**Weekly Review (Aug 31 – Sep 6, 2026)**

- **Sample size is meaningless:** One trade = 100% win rate. Don't read this as a strategy edge; treat it as noise. Need at least 20–30 trades before drawing conclusions.
- **Iron condor worked, but untested:** Single winner of +Rs. 1,500. Need to verify the credit collected vs. margin used to assess actual ROI — on a notional basis, this may be low-yield for the risk locked up.
- **No losing trades, so no pain points to fix** — but also no stress-tested execution. Did you hold to expiry, close early, or adjust? Document the exit rationale; it matters more than the P&L.
- **No patterns logged = blind spot.** Start tagging every trade with setup type, IV regime, DTE, and exit reason. Without metadata, you can't tell if the win was skill or right-tail luck.
- **Action for next week:** Diversify across at least 2 strategies (e.g., add a directional or spread setup) so you're not relying on a single theta-positive structure in an uncertain vol environment, and log every trade with tags.
